pm_verdict_round_6.source: PR #1372 review comment 5161105854, 2026-08-03T00:27:45Z, verified via gh api
corrections_applied: Journal write-boundary corrected: round 5's claim that sticky-bit mode 1770 plus chmod 0444 prevents the deploy account from deleting/renaming its own finalized entries was false (sticky bit protects against non-owner deletion, not owner-on-own-file; chmod governs content access, not unlink/rename, which depend on directory write permission). Replaced with a root-owned write boundary: journal directory root:root mode 0700, deploy account has zero direct filesystem access, all writes go through a fixed sudoers-scoped root-owned helper (§5.5)

Sequence/index crash recovery fully enumerated: introduced sequence-addressable canonical storage (journal/ops/{sequence}/) plus a tuple-to-sequence index, replacing tuple-path-only addressing that had no bounded-scan mechanism. journal/current now points at operation identity (a directory), not a cached record snapshot, closing the case round 5's staleness check could not detect (confirmation lands, current's recorded sequence unchanged since it equals the intent's). Six crash states enumerated and classified unknown (§5.5)

Every remaining pre-round-5 timestamp-ordering/shape-checked-provenance reference swept and corrected to the single journal_sequence rule: §3.5's selection rule, §9's rollback-precedence and SHA-shape language, §13's selection description, and regression row 12
§12's stale 'Open decision for PM' language resolved to reflect round-5's approval-in-principle for §12a and round-6's reconfirmation that §12b remains not pre-authorized

pm_verdict_round_7.source: PR #1372 review comment 5161476245, 2026-08-03T01:47:45Z, verified via gh api
corrections_applied: Rollback provenance corrected: round 6's rule treated a historical deployed_tag->source_sha mapping as an equally-valid verified source alongside the image's own embedded org.opencontainers.image.revision label. That is unsound because deployed_tag is a mutable registry reference (this document's own section 5 establishes that) -- a tag can be re-pointed at a new image after an earlier confirmation, silently invalidating the historical mapping. Fixed: the label, read via docker inspect after the rollback mutation, is now the sole authoritative source; a matching historical mapping may only corroborate it; disagreement between the two is unreadable/unknown, never resolved by preferring either value; absent/malformed label is likewise unknown (section 8, section 9, regression row 41)

Observer read-path corrected: round 6 offered a supplementary reader group as an alternative to the root-owned forced-command helper, but this is incoherent under the journal directory's own root:root mode 0700 -- no group can read a 0700 directory without changing its mode. Removed the group alternative entirely; the observer reads only through the fixed root-owned helper's read-only subcommand, with an explicit allowlisted-fields-only contract (no caller-controlled paths, no arbitrary subcommands) (section 5.5, regression row 42)
PR body and review history reconciled to the stationary head: scenario count corrected (35 -> 42), round 6 and round 7 review history recorded (previously only round 5 was documented)
